Chapter 530: Chapter 20: Class Eight Citizen (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 530: Chapter 20: Class Eight Citizen (Please Subscribe)_2

First and foremost was the Eighth Rank Evolution Elixir, which could forcibly elevate a Seventh Rank Evolver to the Eighth Rank. Although it only provided the basic destructive power of the Eighth Rank, it was far inferior to those who had opened their Inner World and experienced the Heart Demon Tribulation, achieving perfection.

These forcibly promoted Eighth Rank Evolvers could not even beat some of the Seventh-Rank Peak Evolvers.

But at least their lifespan was not worse than that of the normal Eighth Rank Evolvers.

This was also something that the officials of Human Civilization hoped for; as long as an Eighth-Level Citizen was alive, they could potentially create immense value for Human Civilization.

As for combat power? Human Civilization had not yet fallen to the point where it needed Eighth-Level Citizens to protect the continuation of the species.

What were all those Evolvers and Star Lords for?

...

“Automatically become the Chief Councilor of the North Cold Star Alliance?”

Lin Yuan glanced at one of the privileges of an Eighth-Level Citizen.

The North Cold Star Alliance was the current Star Alliance in the Milky Way Star Region, a newly established alliance that encompassed one thousand three hundred thirty-five Star Domains.

The Chief Councilor was the highest-ranking person in a Star Alliance; although unable to directly command the various Star Lords within the alliance, their influence over the Star Domains within the alliance was immense.

They could even impeach or reassign a Star Lord based on their actions.

Currently, the North Cold Star Alliance, being a nascent Star Alliance, had not yet had a Chief Councilor, which made Lin Yuan the de facto first Chief Councilor.

Which meant that Lin Yuan was now, without a doubt, the highest-ranking person in the North Cold Star Alliance.

Especially in this Fringe Starfield Star Alliance, where the divisions of the major Star Domains were not yet stabilized, the powers of the Chief Councilor were immensely terrifying.

“Respected Eighth-Level Citizen Lin Yuan, Scholar, would you like to keep the identity of Chief Councilor hidden?”

The solemn, cold voice of the Goddess of Wisdom rang out.

The names of councillors in each Star Alliance would be listed on the council-member list, and the name of the Chief Councilor would likewise appear on an even higher-level list.

“Hide it.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Revealing his identity as Chief Councilor held only disadvantages and no advantages for him; after all, he would still enjoy all the rights associated with the position.

“An Eighth-Level Citizen can also establish an Evolver family with the ‘Human’ prefix?”

Lin Yuan continued to browse the privileges of an Eighth-Level Citizen and was suddenly shocked when he saw this.

Evolver families in Human Civilization were countless, with many being established and disappearing every day.

However, Evolver families that could add the prefix ‘Human’ were exceedingly rare and almost never vanished.

Evolver families with the ‘Human’ prefix were under the protection of the entire Human Civilization and would coexist with Human Civilization unless they committed acts of ‘treason.’

All Evolver families aimed to have the ‘Human’ prefix as their highest goal; it was an unprecedented honor.

“I hadn’t expected that becoming an Eighth-Rank Citizen could qualify one for this…”

Lin Yuan was amazed internally; the many privileges and benefits of being a high-ranking Eighth-Level Citizen were protected by high-level secrecy.

One would not know what privileges were available until reaching that level.

“Human prefix Evolver family…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts wandered.

For instance, if he were now to establish an Evolver family, it could be named ‘Human the Lin Family.’

Members of an Evolver family with the Human prefix could enjoy the favoritism of the three goddesses and a certain degree of resource predilection.

“Other privileges…”

Lin Yuan steadied his mind and continued reading.

The privileges and benefits owned by an Eighth-Level Citizen were many and were enhanced versions of those available to Seventh-Level Citizens, such as having a guard troops comprised entirely of Seventh Rank Evolvers.

Eighth-Level Citizens, however, were entitled to a guard troops made up of Eighth Rank Evolvers.

But this aspect was of no significance to Lin Yuan.

A guard troops comprised of Eighth Rank Evolvers? With Lin Yuan’s current strength, he could easily kill invincible beings of the Eighth Layer, let alone ordinary Eighth Rank Evolvers.

…

Virtual World, a Mysterious Space.

Shadows of five Supreme Beings, including Xia Qin Supreme Being, Ancient Power Supreme Being, and Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, appeared, sitting regally on a grand main seat.

“Heh, heh, heh, those Tianyu Clan fools still want to take the opportunity to strike at us humans…” Xia Qin Supreme Being sneered.

As both human civilization and the Tianyu Clan were Peak Clans, their Supreme Beings, including ancestors, had clashed, and Xia Qin Supreme Being held them in contempt.

Because those bird people never dared to fight him head-on, always utilizing their Evolution Path’s ‘authority’ to engage in hit-and-run tactics.

“The Tianyu Clan really took a hit this time.” Feather Butterfly Supreme Being said with a light laugh.

Everything that had happened on Battlefield B0001 was in their sight; they were even speculating whether the ancestors of the Tianyu Clan, anguished and enraged, would disregard the risks and enter the fray themselves.

Lin Yuan had deliberately shown weakness, allowing the Tianyu Clan geniuses to come to him seeking their own deaths; even though these geniuses were just avatars, they had completely lost face.

Especially for a Supreme Being, looking down upon the cosmic starry skies, fearless and invincible, there aren’t many things they care about, but their own face is definitely among them.

When kinfolk get pinned down and slaughtered by human youngsters, isn’t that a disgrace?

“However, speaking of which, the Galaxy Master, that little one, is indeed unreasonably strong. Apart from those extremely rare, even unique life forms, can our human civilization’s Evolvers also press down from the Eighth Layer to the Ninth Layer?”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being couldn’t help saying.

Although he himself is a Supreme Being, upon introspection, he admitted that his combat power when at the Eighth-Layer was absolutely nowhere close to that of Lin Yuan.

“Let me take a look.”

The Xia Qin Supreme Being looked forward, as scenes of Lin Yuan in action on the battlefield appeared one after another.

“Understanding the Complete Space Rules, and halfway through the Fusion Rules, yet the merged power is indeed excessively strong.”

The Xia Qin Supreme Being nodded slightly.

Even though he knew Lin Yuan had grasped three types of higher Cosmic Forces and the Complete Space Rules, and their fusion was bound to be unusually powerful, wasn’t this a bit too much?

“Perhaps it’s because this youngster has opened a special path of evolution?” The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being said with a smile, “But isn’t it a good thing that this youngster is becoming stronger? If our human civilization can produce such a genius, it will only become stronger in the future.”

“That’s true.”

The Xia Qin Supreme Being and the Ancient Power Supreme Being nodded slightly.

Only in this way, human civilization could flourish forever.

“Right.”

“The time is almost up, isn’t that Cosmic Secret Realm about to open?”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being suddenly said.

“That Cosmic Secret Realm…” The Xia Qin Supreme Being frowned.

A so-called Cosmic Secret Realm is essentially a small world dependent on the Main World.

They were originally hidden deep within multiple spatial layers, but due to some reason, they made contact with the main spatial layer.

The Black Abyss Clan from the Insect Race Alliance, for example, originated from the Heiyuan Secret Realm.

The spatial layer where the Heiyuan Secret Realm was located formed a conduit with the universe’s main space layer, and the Insect Race’s Supreme Beings joined forces to forcibly drag the Heiyuan Secret Realm into the main space.

This was how the Black Abyss Clan came to be.

“The last time that Cosmic Secret Realm opened was two hundred thousand years ago. I remember our human civilization suffered a lot…”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being said.

“But we also gained a lot.”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being replied.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan was fully immersed in comprehending the ‘Chaos Crystal’.

This treasure, accidentally obtained by the Demonic Jade Tower Master, was greatly significant for Lin Yuan’s Fusion Rules.

Even though the Chaos Crystal did not contain the Space Rules or Taiji Rules, or many demonstrations of Cosmic Forces merging.

Seeing other rule mergers, especially the fusion between foundational and pivotal rules, deeply moved Lin Yuan.

To extrapolate one-to-ten.

To extrapolate one-to-hundred.

“Once the Space Rules completely merge with the Taiji Rules, as well as numerous cosmic forces, a tremendous transformation will surely occur, by then, the power of the fused forces will undoubtedly be beyond what only merging halfway could achieve.”

While Lin Yuan was comprehending, he was simultaneously thinking about this realization.

…

After the fusion had progressed more than halfway, Lin Yuan distinctly felt it becoming increasingly difficult.

However, possessing Against-Heaven’s Understanding, along with the ‘Chaos Crystal’, and occasionally revisiting “Void Interpretation”,

Lin Yuan’s fusion speed was still advancing at a pace unreachable for an ordinary Seventh-Rank Peak Evolver.

This day.

Lin Yuan was continuously attempting to fuse rules.

Suddenly.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

“The teacher is looking for me?”

After pondering for a while, Lin Yuan split a strand of consciousness, connected to the Virtual World, to meet the Chikun Star Lord.
